SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CODES WHERE CODE_TYPE = ? AND CODE_VAL = :B1
SELECT LOWER(RAWTOHEX(STANDARD_HASH(UTL_RAW.CAST_TO_RAW(:B1 ), ?))) FROM DUAL

SELECT ID, STATUS_CD, SUSPENDED_ON, PLAN_ID FROM (SELECT S.ID, S.STATUS_CD, S.SUSPENDED_ON, S.PLAN_ID FROM SUBSCRIPTIONS S WHERE S.TENANT_ID = :B3 AND S.STARTS_ON <= :B2 AND (S.ENDS_ON IS NULL OR S.ENDS_ON >= :B1 ) ORDER BY S.STARTS_ON DESC) WHERE ROWNUM <= 1
SELECT ID FROM (SELECT S.ID FROM SUBSCRIPTIONS S WHERE S.TENANT_ID = :B3 AND S.STARTS_ON <= :B2 AND (S.ENDS_ON IS NULL OR S.ENDS_ON >= :B1 ) ORDER BY S.STARTS_ON DESC) WHERE ROWNUM <= 1

SELECT     NVL(SUM(C1),0), NVL(SUM(C2),0), COUNT(DISTINCT C3), COUNT(DISTINCT C4), NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN C4 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) FROM (SELECT   1 AS C1, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(TENANTS.NAME,1,LENGTH(:B1))=:B2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS C2, SUBSTR(TENANTS.NAME,1,LENGTH(:B1)) AS C3, TENANTS.ID AS C4 FROM OW_BILLING.TENANTS TENANTS) SAMPLESUB

SELECT     NVL(SUM(C1),0), NVL(SUM(C2),0) FROM (SELECT   1 AS C1, CASE WHEN S.TENANT_ID=:B1 AND S.STARTS_ON<=:B2 AND (S.ENDS_ON IS NULL OR S.ENDS_ON>=:B3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS C2 FROM OW_BILLING.SUBSCRIPTIONS S) SAMPLESUB
INSERT INTO INVOICES ( ID, TENANT_ID, PERIOD_ID, ISSUED_AT, SUBTOTAL, TAX, TOTAL, STATUS_CD ) VALUES ( :B4 , :B3 , :B2 , CAST(:B1 AS TIMESTAMP), 0, 0, 0, 20 )
SELECT ID, STATUS_CD FROM SUBSCRIPTIONS WHERE TENANT_ID = :B2 AND ENDS_ON IS NULL AND STARTS_ON < :B1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT 1 AS LINE_NO, ? AS LINE_TYPE, :B2 AS DESCRIPTION, ROUND(:B1 , 2) AS AMOUNT, 0 AS TAX_AMOUNT, 0 AS CREDIT_APPLIED, ROUND(:B1 , 2) AS TOTAL FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 2, ?, ?, ROUND(:B3 , 2), 0, 0, ROUND(:B3 , 2) FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 3, ?, ?, :B4 / 2, 0, 0, :B4 / 2 FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 4, ?, ?, :B4 / 2, 0, 0, :B4 / 2 FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 5, ?, ?, 0, 0, :B5 , -:B5 FROM DUAL

                       VALUES (:1, :2, :3, DATE ?, 10)

SELECT DECODE(:B4 , ?, 0, (:B3 + :B2 ) * :B1 ) FROM DUAL

                       VALUES (:1, :2, :3, 10)

SELECT     NVL(SUM(C1),:SYS_B_0), NVL(SUM(C2),:SYS_B_1) FROM (SELECT   :SYS_B_2 AS C1, :SYS_B_3 AS C2 FROM OW_BILLING.RATING_RESULTS RATING_RESULTS) SAMPLESUB

SELECT     NVL(SUM(C1),:SYS_B_0), NVL(SUM(C2),:SYS_B_1) FROM (SELECT   :SYS_B_2 AS C1, :SYS_B_3 AS C2 FROM OW_BILLING.TENANTS TENANTS) SAMPLESUB
UPDATE TENANTS SET STATUS_CD = 20 WHERE ID = :B1

INSERT INTO NOTIFICATIONS (ID, TENANT_ID, KIND_CD, SENT_AT) SELECT PKG_OW_UTIL.F_MD5_UUID(:B2 || ? || TO_CHAR(TRUNC(:B1 ), ?)), :B2 , 3, CAST(TRUNC(:B1 ) AS TIMESTAMP) FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM NOTIFICATIONS WHERE TENANT_ID = :B2 AND KIND_CD = 3 AND SENT_AT = CAST(TRUNC(:B1 ) AS TIMESTAMP))

SELECT     NVL(SUM(C1),:SYS_B_0), NVL(SUM(C2),:SYS_B_1), COUNT(DISTINCT C3), NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN C3 IS NULL THEN :SYS_B_2 ELSE :SYS_B_3 END),:SYS_B_4) FROM (SELECT   :SYS_B_5 AS C1, :SYS_B_6 AS C2, SUBSCRIPTIONS.TENANT_ID AS C3 FROM OW_BILLING.SUBSCRIPTIONS SUBSCRIPTIONS) SAMPLESUB
SELECT     NVL(SUM(C1),:SYS_B_0), NVL(SUM(C2),:SYS_B_1) FROM (SELECT   :SYS_B_2 AS C1, :SYS_B_3 AS C2 FROM OW_BILLING.RATING_PERIODS RATING_PERIODS) SAMPLESUB
